title: ci: run main's full battery every 4 hours instead of hourly (CI and Lint schedules), and CodeQL daily instead of on every push to main (maintainer ruling Q6 = C)
body:
Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed. Tesla ruled the whole-project assessment's Q6 on 2026-10-25 09:23Z in the director thread, answering "A = keep hourly; B = skip when the SHA is unchanged (saves most, loses flake detection); C = lower the frequency to about every 4 hours, logic unchanged", plus "CodeQL on every push … can be filed directly": 「D4 · 固定发版日 没必要；其他同意 ，npm dist-tag 手工清理 应该立一张管理者维护的卡」 — "其他同意" = C. ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

Governing text: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` `on.schedule` (#16467's hourly full run), `.github/workflows/lint.yml` `on.schedule` (same ruling, the half that file owns), `.github/workflows/codeql.yml` `on`.

## The change

- `ci.yml` and `lint.yml`: `cron: '0 * * * *'` → every 4 hours (`'0 */4 * * *'` or an offset of it). Job logic unchanged: the scheduled run stays the full battery and keeps finding flakes on green SHAs (objectui 8/78, objectstack 4/37 such reds in the assessment window — the reason B was not chosen).
- `codeql.yml`: drop the `push: main` trigger, run daily on a schedule (keep the weekly deep pass or fold it into the daily one), keep `workflow_dispatch` if present.
- Update the readers that assume one scheduled run per hour, e.g. `scripts/ci/select-shard-timings-run.mjs` ("wants one complete run per hour"), `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs` and the "THE HOURLY FULL RUN" comments; `grep -rln hourly scripts/ci scripts/*.mjs` lists 11 candidate files on `5874d25`. Fix any freshness window that would now read a 4-hour gap as missing.
  Re-check: `grep -n "cron" .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/workflows/lint.yml .github/workflows/codeql.yml`

## Explicitly not in this card

Dropping the push-to-main runs of CI/Lint. Measured on `5874d25`, those runs are not copies of the merge_group run: merge_group carries the fast set while push carries the post-merge-only jobs (dogfood ×3, dogfood-verify, temporal-conformance, console-pin) attributed per commit (#25373), and push runs are the only writers of the main Turbo seeds that PR runs restore (`ci.yml` save steps `if: always() && github.event_name == 'push'`). That half went back to the maintainer with the corrected premise; it gets its own card only if re-ruled.

## Business rationale

The scheduled full battery is ~24 runs/day, most on an unchanged SHA (21/37 on an already-run SHA in the assessment window); CodeQL ran 100 times in 25.9 h with 86 cancelled. Every one of those runner-minutes competes with PR and merge-queue capacity, i.e. with how fast product work lands. Cutting the schedule to 6 runs/day keeps the flake detector statistically alive at about a quarter of the cost.

Serial constraint: the objectui-merge cutover (#25752) lands PR B #25697 and 4a #25745 which edit `ci.yml` / `lint.yml`; land outside the cutover freeze window. After cutover the merged `Test UI` jobs live in `ci.yml` and inherit this cadence; the objectui repo's own hourly schedule is objectui#13448's business. Workflow files = governed surface (Tier H), human merge.

Reader: the devx seat after triage. Effort S.

Duplicate check: semantic searches "hourly scheduled full run CI cron frequency push to main duplicate CodeQL every push" (objectstack, 43 hits: the "hourly full run: red on main" incident cards, none about cadence) and "codeql schedule daily instead of every push" (1 hit, #16467 closed, the card that created the hourly run). No duplicate.
